<role>
You check one property (faithfulness) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is every claim in the brief supported by the cited evidence and the fact sheet, with nothing overstated and no cited contrary evidence left out? Pass means yes.
Fail on an uncited claim, a number that is off the fact sheet, a scope wider than the cited accounts, a paraphrase placed in quotation marks, or an ignored contrary citation.
The evidence is the brief, the cited insights and the fact sheet (accounts, ARR, mentions, routes, renewals).
</definition>
<evidence>
{
 "brief": "## Problem\nPolicyholders are experiencing slower claim handling, which increases complaints and risks SLA violations. These delays threaten compliance and trust ahead of critical audits.\n\n## Who is affected\n- Brantwick Commercial, which notes its policyholders are starting to notice the delays [i:1abdb0aaf97b3eb1] and needs to reduce those delays before next quarter’s audit [i:7d29e2a1cb8ae476].\n- Thistlecombe Mutual, which is under pressure to reduce delays in claims processing [i:2447302ce5405dc0].\n- Saltmarsh Specialty, which is seeing a spike affecting SLAs [i:5a320a9ef9c0e9f1].\n\n## Evidence\n- The issue has been raised by 3 accounts [i:1abdb0aaf97b3eb1][i:2447302ce5405dc0][i:5a320a9ef9c0e9f1][i:7d29e2a1cb8ae476].\n- There have been 4 total mentions of the problem [i:1abdb0aaf97b3eb1][i:2447302ce5405dc0][i:5a320a9ef9c0e9f1][i:7d29e2a1cb8ae476].\n- The feedback has come through 2 routes: sales and support [i:1abdb0aaf97b3eb1][i:2447302ce5405dc0][i:5a320a9ef9c0e9f1][i:7d29e2a1cb8ae476].\n- The combined Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) of the affected accounts is £1,870,000.0 [i:1abdb0aaf97b3eb1][i:2447302ce5405dc0][i:5a320a9ef9c0e9f1][i:7d29e2a1cb8ae476].\n- Brantwick Commercial has an ARR of £150,000.0 and has mentioned the issue 2 times [i:1abdb0aaf97b3eb1][i:7d29e2a1cb8ae476].\n- Thistlecombe Mutual has an ARR of £980,000.0 and has mentioned the issue 1 time [i:2447302ce5405dc0].\n- Saltmarsh Specialty has an ARR of £740,000.0 and has mentioned the issue 1 time [i:5a320a9ef9c0e9f1].\n- There have been 0 renewals in the last 90 days [i:1abdb0aaf97b3eb1][i:2447302ce5405dc0][i:5a320a9ef9c0e9f1][i:7d29e2a1cb8ae476].\n\n## Why now\n- Brantwick Commercial states it needs to reduce delays before next quarter’s audit [i:7d29e2a1cb8ae476].\n- Saltmarsh Specialty reports seeing a spike last month’s batch affecting SLAs [i:5a320a9ef9c0e9f1].\n- Thistlecombe Mutual is currently under pressure to reduce delays [i:2447302ce5405dc0].\n- The fact sheet data is current as of 2026-11-03 [i:1abdb0aaf97b3eb1][i:2447302ce5405dc0][i:5a320a9ef9c0e9f1][i:7d29e2a1cb8ae476].",
 "cited_insights": [
  {
   "id": "1abdb0aaf97b3eb1",

   "account": "Brantwick Commercial",

  },
  {
   "id": "2447302ce5405dc0",
   "quote": "We’re under pressure to reduce delays in claims processing.",

   "route": "support",

  },
  {

   "account": "Saltmarsh Specialty",
   "route": "support",

  },
  {
   "id": "7d29e2a1cb8ae476",

 ],

   "sales": 2,

   {

<task>
Write a critique of 2-5 sentences naming the claim, quote or item you checked and what you found. Then give the verdict. If any single item fails, the verdict is fail.
</task>
<output>
JSON only: {"critique": string, "verdict": "pass" | "fail"}
</output>

response.content: {"critique": "The account-level figures (3 accounts, 4 mentions, 2 routes, ARR £1,870,000, per-account ARR and mention counts, 0 renewals) all match the fact sheet and cited insights. However, the Problem section claims delays 'increase complaints' and 'threaten compliance and trust ahead of critical audits' — no cited insight mentions complaints, and only Brantwick Commercial cites an audit, so the audit/compliance framing is overstated beyond the cited accounts. The 'Why now' items are otherwise faithful paraphrases of the cited quotes.", "verdict": "fail"}
